subject: a snow ridge catching first light
art_direction: 蓝白雪脊低低铺开，桃色光沿顶端抹过，前景纹理简洁干净。
visible_description: 蓝白雪脊低低铺开，桃色光沿顶端抹过，前景纹理简洁干净。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Place a blue-white snow ridge diagonally across the lower half, with a thin peach highlight along its upper edge. Keep the nearest wind-carved texture subtle and the distant peaks low and softly layered. A pale cool sky occupies the open upper space. Use clean atmospheric transitions and no climbers or equipment, conveying clear, unforced optimism through light and shape. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
